Key Facts (updated 18 October 2026)

  • Emaar India is the Indian company of Dubai's Emaar Properties (builder of the Burj Khalifa). It was set up in 2005 as Emaar MGF and has been on its own since 2016 (Wikipedia: Emaar India).
  • In Lucknow, Emaar built the Gomti Greens township — RERA lists it as completed on 22 December 2023 (RERA record).
  • Its new project, Elite Oasis in Gomti Nagar Extension, is a 35-floor tower of 3 and 4 BHK flats, launched on 2 June 2025; RERA no. UPRERAPRJ944123/02/2025, completion date 17 November 2029 (launch announcement, 2 Jun 2025, RERA record).
  • Launch prices were about ₹2.75–4.15 crore; the foundation was laid on 13 March 2026 (launch announcement, 2 Jun 2025, Realty n More, 14 Mar 2026).
  • In September 2025 Emaar said it has no plans to sell its stake in Emaar India (Realty Today, 21 Sep 2025).

If you have seen hoardings for Emaar in Lucknow and wondered who they are, this guide explains it in plain words: what Emaar is, how its Indian company works, what it has built in Lucknow, and what to check before you buy an Emaar flat or plot. Every fact has a source link; where two sources disagree, we show both.

What is Emaar? (in simple words)

Emaar Properties is a large real estate company from Dubai, founded in 1997 by Mohamed Alabbar and listed on the Dubai Financial Market. It built and owns the Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building, and built The Dubai Mall and Downtown Dubai (Wikipedia: Emaar Properties).

Emaar India is its Indian company, headquartered in Gurugram. It started in 2005 as a joint venture with the Indian developer MGF, under the name Emaar MGF. That partnership ended on 11 April 2016, and the company is now Emaar India Limited — RERA still shows it as "formerly known as Emaar MGF Land Limited" (Wikipedia: Emaar India, RERA record). It builds in Delhi-NCR (mainly Gurugram), Mohali, Lucknow, Indore and other cities.

What this means for you

When you buy an Emaar flat in Lucknow, your agreement is with Emaar India Limited — an Indian company governed by Indian law and UP RERA — not with the Dubai company. The Dubai parent's fame is a good sign, but your protection comes from the RERA registration of your specific project.

Who owns Emaar India now?

In 2025 Emaar held talks to sell its India business, with the Adani Group named as a leading contender. In September 2025, Emaar told the Dubai Financial Market that it has no plans to divest its stake in its Indian entity and is instead exploring partnerships with large Indian groups (Realty Today, 21 Sep 2025). We have found no later announcement of a sale or joint venture as of 18 October 2026.

Emaar in Lucknow — the two projects

1. Gomti Greens township (completed)

Gomti Greens is Emaar's integrated township in Lucknow — an "integrated township" means plots, homes, roads, parks and shops planned together by one developer. The main township is registered with UP RERA as UPRERAPRJ5635: approval date 1 October 2013, completion date 22 December 2023, land area 462,766 sq m (about 114 acres), and RERA shows it as fully built (RERA record). Property portals often quote bigger figures (over 230 acres) — those are marketing numbers; use the RERA figure for your phase.

Carpet area vs super area — the most important thing to understand

The size in an advertisement is usually super area: your flat plus a share of walls, lobbies, lifts, staircases and the clubhouse. Carpet area is the floor you actually use inside your flat, and it is what RERA records. For Elite Oasis, the 3 BHK is advertised at about 2,640 sq ft, while its RERA carpet area is about 1,494 sq ft — the advertised figure is roughly 1.75 times the usable area. This is normal in high-rises, but always compare price per sq ft of carpet area, and make sure your agreement states carpet area as per RERA.

Buying from Emaar in Lucknow? Check these first

  1. RERA number of your exact project or phase — search it on up-rera.in and check that the promoter is Emaar India Limited.
  2. Carpet area — your agreement must state the RERA carpet area; compare price per sq ft of carpet area across projects.
  3. Completion date — for Elite Oasis, 17 November 2029. Read the quarterly progress report on up-rera.in before each big payment.
  4. Payment plan and charges — ask in writing for parking, club, maintenance deposit and other charges on top of the base price.
  5. Resale in Gomti Greens — ask for the seller's registered sale deed, the original allotment or conveyance from Emaar, dues clearance from the maintenance body, and an encumbrance certificate; check past registries on IGRSUP.
  6. Plot buyers — confirm the plot number on the approved layout and whether a house plan has to follow the township's building rules.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Is Emaar in Lucknow the same company that built the Burj Khalifa?

Emaar India is the Indian arm of Emaar Properties of Dubai, the company that built and owns the Burj Khalifa. Emaar India is a separate Indian company headquartered in Gurugram (Wikipedia: Emaar India); it was called Emaar MGF Land Limited until its joint venture with MGF ended in 2016.

What projects does Emaar have in Lucknow?

Two: the Gomti Greens township, which RERA lists as completed in December 2023, with phases such as Hridayam and Samarth; and Elite Oasis, a 35-floor apartment tower in Gomti Nagar Extension launched in June 2025 and due for completion in November 2029 (RERA record, RERA record).

What is the price of Emaar Elite Oasis?

At launch in June 2025, reported prices were about ₹2.75–2.90 crore for 3 BHK and ₹3.87–4.15 crore for 4 BHK (launch announcement, 2 Jun 2025); another report gave ₹2.95 crore as the starting price (Knocksense, 3 Jun 2025). Prices change — ask for the current price list and check the carpet area in the RERA record.

Why is the RERA area smaller than the advertised flat size?

Advertised sizes are usually super (saleable) area, which adds walls, lobbies, lifts and common areas. RERA records carpet area — the usable floor inside your flat. For Elite Oasis, the 3 BHK is advertised at about 2,640 sq ft but its RERA carpet area is 138.775 sq m, about 1,494 sq ft (Knocksense, 3 Jun 2025, RERA record).

Is Emaar India being sold to Adani?

In 2025 Emaar held sale talks, including with the Adani Group. In September 2025 Emaar told the Dubai Financial Market it has no plans to divest its stake in its Indian entity and is instead exploring partnerships with large Indian groups (Realty Today, 21 Sep 2025).

When will Elite Oasis be completed?

The RERA completion date is 17 November 2029 (RERA record). The foundation was laid on 13 March 2026 (Realty n More, 14 Mar 2026).
